method: Interest + relevance + novelty + familiarity + consequence + source confidence + originality. Social leads cannot auto-publish without corroboration.

publishReady.headline: Burlington’s ward map changed. Check yours before voting.
publishReady.summary: New boundaries are in effect for the 2026 municipal election, so some residents will vote in a different councillor race.
publishReady.why: Your ward determines which councillor candidates and voting locations apply to you.
publishReady.storyGoal: Your ward determines which councillor candidates and voting locations apply to you.

publishReady.headline: Candidate nominations have closed. Here is the registered field.
publishReady.summary: Burlington’s nomination deadline passed Aug. 21. The City’s candidate list now shows five people registered to run for mayor.
publishReady.why: The official list shows voters who is registered in every Burlington race.
publishReady.storyGoal: The official list shows voters who is registered in every Burlington race.

publishReady.headline: What 26,503 fish revealed about a damaged local marsh.
publishReady.summary: The hopeful Fishway count masks a harder restoration problem involving water quality, invasive species and low oxygen.
publishReady.why: The count shows both ecological progress and what the Fishway cannot repair on its own.
publishReady.storyGoal: The count shows both ecological progress and what the Fishway cannot repair on its own.
